settings.title: AI Setup
settings.subtitle: Choose the AI that writes your questions and checks your answers.
settings.noModelsFound: No models found. Ensure you have pulled a model (e.g. ollama pull llama3.1).
settings.ollamaInfo: Any OpenAI-compatible server: a local Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1) or a remote URL (https://example.com/api/v1). Make sure the model is available on that server.
settings.ollamaUrlHelp: Can be http://localhost:11434/v1, local LAN IP, or URL (https://example.com/api/v1). Suffix /v1 is handled automatically.
settings.fetchModelsHelp: Click "Fetch Models" to list the models on your server, or type one manually.
settings.apiKeyOptionalPlaceholder: Leave empty if no auth token required...
settings.apiKeyOptionalHelp: Optional: provide if your reverse proxy is protected by a Bearer token.
settings.apiKeyHelp: Stored on your device. Never sent to our servers.

practice.generatingText: AI is preparing questions based on your configuration.
practice.kanjiInstruction: How is this word read? Type it in hiragana or say it.

practice.readingInstruction: Read the text above, then choose the best answer.
